product.name: Valentine’s Picnic Day at Elysian Hills
product.shortDescription: Celebrate Valentine’s Day with an elevated picnic experience set high above the hinterland.
product.description:
Celebrate Valentine’s Day with an elevated picnic experience set high above the hinterland.

Whether you’re planning a romantic afternoon with your partner or gathering your favourite people for a stylish Galentine’s celebration, our Valentine’s Picnic Day offers a relaxed yet luxurious way to mark the occasion.

With sweeping views, beautifully styled grazing boxes, curated beverages, and a selection of optional enhancements, this one-day-only event is designed for those who value connection, atmosphere, and unforgettable experiences.

Event Details

Date: Saturday 14 February 2026
Time: 3:00pm – 6:00pm
Price: $120 for two
Group Size: Two adults per picnic

Children under 12 are welcome at no additional cost.

What’s Included

Each picnic booking includes a thoughtfully curated experience, designed to feel indulgent yet effortless.

Grazing Box

Each group receives a grazing box, featuring:

  • King Island Camembert with crackers & spreads

  • Chargrilled chicken with lemon roll

  • Sundried tomato penne pasta salad

  • Baby quiche Lorraines

  • Pork & fennel sausage rolls

  • Biscuits & seasonal fruit

Included Drink

Choose one of the following options per group:

Wine

  • 1 × Cloud St Sparkling Brut

  • 1 × Cloud St Chardonnay

  • 1 × Cloud St Shiraz

Beer

  • 4 × Stone & Wood Pacific Ale

  • 4 × Corona

  • 4 × Great Northern Original

Drink Upgrades

For those looking to elevate their celebration, premium drink upgrades are available:

  • Bandini Prosecco +$15

  • Moët & Chandon Brut Impérial +$65

  • Craggy Range Sauvignon Blanc +$15

  • Maison AIX Rosé +$15

  • Fringe Society Pinot Noir +$15

Perfect for romantic toasts, Galentine’s cheers, or simply turning your picnic into something extra special.

Optional Enhancements & Experiences

Transform your picnic into a full romantic or celebratory escape with our optional add-ons, designed to extend the experience beyond the picnic itself.

Eco Cruise (Pre-Picnic)

Begin your afternoon with a peaceful eco cruise before heading up to Elysian Hills. A beautiful way to slow down, take in the landscape, and ease into the celebration.

Book a cruise

Dinner at Potager

Continue your Valentine’s or Galentine’s celebrations with an unforgettable farm-to-table dining experience at Potager. A seamless way to turn your afternoon picnic into a complete day (or night) of indulgence.

book a table

Romantic Accommodation Packages

Make a night of it with on-site or nearby accommodation:

  • Stay at Elysian Hills and wake up to panoramic hinterland views

  • Or retreat to Cascade Springs for a secluded, nature-immersed escape

Accommodation packages are ideal for couples celebrating Valentine’s Day or friends turning Galentine’s into a weekend getaway.

explore our accommodation options

Beverages Available for Purchase on the Day

A pop-up bar will be available throughout the event, offering:

Beer
Wine

Cocktails

  • Strawberry Caprioska

  • Mojito

  • Aperol Spritz

Perfect for relaxed refills as the afternoon unfolds.

A Limited, One-Day-Only Experience

With only 15 picnic bookings available, this event is intentionally intimate and exclusive. Early bookings are strongly recommended to avoid missing out.

Celebrate love, friendship, and connection this February — your way.

Secure your Valentine’s or Galentine’s Picnic today.
